The horizontal axis includes sectors such as steel, machinery, chemicals, aircraft, automobiles, electronics, textiles, and others, and the vertical axis is percentage. According to the legend on the right, City 2 corresponds to the column with dotted/grid-like pattern. Reading the figure shows that the column height of City 2 in the “textiles” item is about 30%, which is clearly relatively high; at the same time, the proportion of “steel” in City 2 is also relatively high, showing the characteristics of a traditional industrial city. Then reason: The four candidate cities are Detroit, Xi'an, Kolkata, and Munich. The textile industry proportion of City 2 is prominent, and combined with the traditional industrial characteristics, City 2 can be judged to be Kolkata. Kolkata is close to the Ganges Delta, and the nearby area is rich in textile raw materials such as jute, so the leading location factor for the development of its textile industry is being close to the raw material producing area.
